pool.text: Diamonds were first discovered in the area.
The true value of the diamond find was recognised.
Albert Kalonji declared himself ruler of the secessionist Mining State of South Kasai.
Mbuji-Mayi grew rapidly upon Congolese independence with the immigration of Luba people.
Albert Kalonji declared himself as emperor of the region in a traditional ceremony.
Government ANC troops took control of the town and arrested Kalonji.
A second assault on the independent state was launched with ANC government troops fighting.
Kalonji was captured again when ANC forces retook Bakwanga.
MIBA was the source of a large percentage of world industrial diamonds.
Nzemba was appointed by Mobutu and considered a powerful political player.
The state-run power plant went out of service leading to widespread deforestation.
The entire city had only about 19.7 km of paved roads.
The city fell to rebels and looting took a toll on mining operations.
Zimbabwean and Chadian troops occupied Mbuji-Mayi as the First Congo War grew.
Amnesty International published a report about people being shot in diamond fields.
Residents obtained water from local rivers contributing to water-borne disease outbreaks.
The DRC government launched a project to improve drinking water.
